page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8a.16xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs utilizing the x86_64 architecture, driven by AMD EPYC 9T24 processors running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance is configured with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through attached network storage volumes. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps. The absence of integrated GPUs and local NVMe storage represents a design tradeoff, prioritizing raw CPU allocation and network-based storage architectures over local disk I/O and hardware acceleration.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio makes this instance suitable for compute-heavy workloads where memory overhead is minimal. It is designed for tasks such as high-traffic web serving, batch processing, continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines, and application servers that require dedicated CPU resources without the premium cost of high-memory configurations.
